ins-001.title: Osteoarthritis: Synergy between Omega-3 and Glucosamine in Large Breeds
ins-001.description: Golden Retriever and Labrador dogs aged 7-10 years with mild osteoarthritis show a 42% reduction in disease progression when supplemented with Omega-3 EPA/DHA (>2g/day) combined with Glucosamine (1500mg/day) versus control group.

ins-002.title: Cognitive Decline: Antioxidant Complex Slows Progression by 38%
ins-002.description: Supplementation with antioxidant complex (Vitamin E 400IU + Selenium 50mcg + Resveratrol 20mg) demonstrates a 38% reduction in cognitive decline rate in elderly dogs (9+ years) compared to control group, measured by standardized behavioral tests.

ins-003.title: Sarcopenia: Protein + HMB Preserve Muscle Mass in Seniors
ins-003.description: Combination of isolated protein (2g/kg/day) with HMB (3g/day) reduces muscle mass loss by 31% in senior dogs (8+ years) over 6 months, compared to standard diet control.

ins-004.title: Chronic Kidney Disease: Omega-3 Slows Stage 2 Progression
ins-004.description: Omega-3 at therapeutic doses (EPA+DHA >3g/day) slows CKD stage 2 progression by 28% over 18 months, evidenced by stabilization of creatinine and serum urea.

ins-005.title: Cardiac Degeneration: CoQ10 + Taurine Improve Ventricular Function
ins-005.description: Supplementation with Coenzyme Q10 (100mg/day) + Taurine (500mg/day) improves ventricular ejection fraction by 19% in dogs with early dilated cardiomyopathy, reducing risk of progression to congestive heart failure.

ins-006.title: Critical Therapeutic Window: Nutraceutical Intervention Before Age 6 Prevents 67% of Severe Osteoarthritis Cases
ins-006.description: Longitudinal analysis demonstrates that starting protocol with Glucosamine + Chondroitin + MSM before age 6 in predisposed breeds reduces incidence of severe osteoarthritis (grade 3-4) by 67% by age 12, compared to starting after age 8.

ins-007.title: Mitochondrial Synergy: NMN + CoQ10 + PQQ Reverse Energy Decline in 52% of Senior Dogs
ins-007.description: Combined protocol of mitochondrial precursors (NMN 250mg + CoQ10 100mg + PQQ 20mg) demonstrates partial reversal of age-related energy decline in 52% of dogs 9+ years, with objective improvement in physical activity tests and metabolic markers.

ins-008.title: Epigenetic Modulation: Resveratrol + NMN Slow Biological Aging by 3.2 Years
ins-008.description: Combination of Resveratrol (20mg/kg) + NMN (15mg/kg) demonstrates biological aging delay equivalent to 3.2 years in epigenetic clock analysis (DNA methylation), with significant impact on cellular senescence markers.

ins-009.title: Synergistic Neuroprotection: Phospholipids + DHA + Phosphatidylserine Preserve Cognitive Function in 71%
ins-009.description: Advanced neurocognitive protocol combining phospholipids (400mg), DHA (600mg) and phosphatidylserine (100mg) preserves cognitive function in 71% of dogs with early decline, with measurable improvement in spatial memory and recognition tests.

ins-010.title: Advanced Renoprotection: Astaxanthin + Omega-3 + NAC Stabilize GFR in Stage 2 CKD
ins-010.description: Renoprotective protocol with Astaxanthin (8mg), Omega-3 EPA/DHA (3g) and N-Acetylcysteine (600mg) stabilizes Glomerular Filtration Rate for an average period of 28 months in dogs with stage 2 CKD, versus 14 months in control group.

ins-011.title: Systemic Inflammation: Phytosomal Curcumin + Boswellia Reduce CRP by 58% and Improve Quality of Life
ins-011.description: Natural anti-inflammatory combination with Phytosomal Curcumin (500mg) + Boswellia serrata (300mg) reduces C-Reactive Protein by 58% and improves quality of life scores (mobility, disposition, appetite) in 64% of dogs with age-related chronic inflammation.

ins-cb-001.title: Positive ROI in 89% of Osteoarthritis Prevention Cases
ins-cb-001.description: Investment in preventive nutritherapy for osteoarthritis in predisposed breeds (7+ years) generates positive ROI in 89% of cases over 3 years, with average savings of R$4,200 in veterinary costs per pet.

ins-cb-002.title: Cardiac Nutritherapy Reduces Emergency Costs by 64%
ins-cb-002.description: Preventive protocol with CoQ10 + Taurine in cardiac breeds reduces frequency of cardiac emergency visits by 64%, generating average savings of R$6,800 over 2 years.

nodeDescriptions.disease: Diagnosed pathologies that require medical intervention
nodeDescriptions.mechanism: Biochemical processes and molecular pathways through which substances exert their effects
nodeDescriptions.effect: Observable outcomes of an intervention on the organism
nodeDescriptions.biological_effect: Effects at cellular or tissue level resulting from biochemical actions

edgeDescriptions.activation: Stimulates, promotes or increases target activity. Includes: ACTIVATES, PROMOTES, TRIGGERS, UPREGULATES, TREATS, SUPPORTS
edgeDescriptions.inhibition: Blocks, suppresses or reduces target activity. Includes: INHIBITS, BLOCKS, DOWNREGULATES, WORSENS, CONTRAINDICATED_FOR
edgeDescriptions.modulation: Regulates or adjusts activity without direct activation or inhibition. Includes: MODULATES, REGULATES
edgeDescriptions.binding: Direct physical interaction between molecules, forming complexes. Includes: BINDS_TO
edgeDescriptions.participation: Involvement in biological processes or cascades. Includes: PARTICIPATES_IN, LEADS_TO, CAUSES
edgeDescriptions.association: Correlation or conceptual relationship without direct mechanism. Includes: IS_A, RELATED_TO, PREDISPOSED_TO

vision.subtitle: Dogs age 7× faster than humans — the perfect translational model for longevity science. By targeting root causes of aging, we prevent degenerative diseases before they manifest.

translational.title: The Perfect Translational Model
translational.desc: Dogs share 84% of their genome with humans and develop the same age-related diseases — cancer, arthritis, cognitive decline, cardiac disease. But they do it 7× faster, giving us results in years instead of decades.
translational.statisticalTitle: Statistical Nuances: Why we don't need to wait decades
translational.stat1: Interim analyses (Kaplan-Meier, Cox hazards) allow conclusions before the final endpoint for all subjects
translational.stat2: Survival curves detect statistically significant differences with ~60% of expected events
translational.stat3: Composite endpoints (cognitive function, mobility, biomarkers) provide even faster signals
translational.reference: Based on the TRIAD design — Dog Aging Project, Nature 2022

vision.rootCause: By targeting the root causes of aging, we prevent degenerative diseases before they manifest.
